//: Type-checking config for the scripts/ tree — every test, migration, backfill and seed.
It exists as a SECOND config rather than a widening of tsconfig.json for one reason:
the build config has `rootDir: ./src` and emits to dist/, so adding scripts/**/* there
would put the whole test corpus into the published build output.
`rootDir` is widened to the project root because scripts/ sits beside src/, and
`noEmit` is set because nothing here is ever built — this config only ever answers
'does it compile'. src/**/* stays included so scripts type-check against the same
declarations tsc uses for the build, including the `declare global` blocks that no
single script's import graph necessarily reaches.
Run via `npm run typecheck:scripts`. See PRODUCTION-READINESS plan step 0.C.
